newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent prices rebound on NYMEX surge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent prices rebound on NYMEX surge.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices rebounded Wednesday on gains in the NYMEX complex fueled by surging crude oil futures, traders said.

Differentials were largely unchanged on the day, leaving prices in Chicago and Group Three to track a nearly 0.75 cent a gallon gain in front-month heating oil and nearly 1.50 cent a gallon gain in unleaded gasoline futures.
Differentials were largely unchanged in the Midwest markets against the rising futures prices, which had opened lower but recovered as oil futures rose to post-Gulf War highs.

Group Three low sulphur diesel remained 6.75/6.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX January heating oil for prompt delivery and 7.0/6.75 cents under the print for later deliveries, with high sulphur 9.75 cents under.
Group Three unleaded was bid 4.25 cents a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 4.75 cents under for late-month deliveries, traders said.
Chicago late-month low sulphur diesel was talked 7.75/7.50 cents a gallon under the print and high sulphur was 8.50/8.25 cents under, traders said.
Chicago unleaded was steady at 5.75/5.50 cents a gallon under the print for prompt and late-month deliveries.
